description:
Development-only add-on to SmartMeterInsights.Base (AB#5252).

Seeds the local-development OIDC client smart-meter-insights-app-debug
(redirect URIs http(s)://localhost:4400/, the Angular dev server) and nothing
else. Install it ALONGSIDE SmartMeterInsights.Base on a local or test
instance; production instances install .Base only.

Why a separate blueprint: `requires` is evaluated per ROOT blueprint, never
per seed file or entity, so whole-blueprint split is the only granularity at
which content can be gated by environment. This is the same pattern the
platform uses for System.Communication.MainLatest / .Release and
System.UI.SystemCockpit / .TenantCockpit.

The `requires` block below makes an install on a staging or production
instance a successful NO-OP (BlueprintApplicationResult.Skipped — no install
row, no seed, no history), so a provisioning script may apply it
unconditionally without branching on the environment.

Until 1.2.0 this client was part of SmartMeterInsights.Base. Because it
declares AutoProvisionInChildTenants, identity mirrored a localhost-only
client into every consulting-firm tenant of the prod-1 app host. Removing it
from .Base does NOT delete an already-provisioned live client — identity
clients are runtime entities and deleting them in production is an operator
decision (open follow-up on AB#5252).

Deliberately NOT declaring blueprintDependencies on SmartMeterInsights.Base:
the two are independent applies, and a dependency edge would only add version
churn — a Skipped root never installs its dependencies anyway.
